title: Eight-Screen Navigation Choreography
scope: Add visible source-exit -> target-entry choreography across the eight canonical screens.
Animate the actual reference surface and native reconstruction together so motion is perceptible.
Preserve all visual assets, layout, typography, colors, and interaction semantics at rest.
Keep Reduced Motion free of travel while preserving source/destination state feedback.
Expand deterministic exact-head evidence to visit all eight canonical screens.

architecture_delta.baseline_state: MainWindow.xaml.cs owns navigation and is already large.
architecture_delta.introduced_delta: Navigation transition orchestration plus a small presentation-only helper.
architecture_delta.smallest_safe_extraction: Extract pure WPF transition mechanics to ScreenTransitionMotion.cs; keep business/runtime truth out of it.
